title: Urgent appeal to find woman after suspected human tissue discovered in Rochdale
excerpt: Police fear a woman who may have recently given birth needs urgent medical attention after a discovery near Watkins Street and Charter Street, off Kingsway.
content_html:
Greater Manchester Police are appealing for information to locate a woman who may need urgent medical attention after evidence suggests she may have recently given birth. The police are treating the situation with urgency and are actively investigating the circumstances surrounding the potential birth-related incident.

Officers have not disclosed specific details about the woman, including her identity or location, but they are urging anyone with information to come forward. The appeal for information is ongoing, and police are committed to treating all contacts in confidence.

This appeal highlights the importance of community assistance in urgent situations where an individual's health may be at risk. The police are particularly focused on ensuring the woman receives the necessary medical care as soon as possible.

Anyone who may have seen the woman or has any relevant information is encouraged to contact Greater Manchester Police. The police are based in the Greater Manchester area and are dedicated to resolving this matter swiftly.
legal_disclaimer: This is a police welfare appeal. No further circumstances have been confirmed in the supplied GMP statement. Please avoid speculation and pass relevant information directly to police.
right_to_reply: Anyone directly affected may request a correction or right of reply by emailing news@rochdaledaily.co.uk.
body:
BREAKING NEWS | ONGOING AND DEVELOPING STORY. This report will be updated when further verified information becomes available.

Detectives are trying to find a woman who may need urgent medical attention after suspected human tissue was discovered off Kingsway in Rochdale.

Greater Manchester Police said evidence found near the junction of Watkins Street and Charter Street suggests a woman may have recently given birth. Officers were called shortly before 9am on Thursday 22 October.

Police have been examining the scene and carrying out enquiries. Their priority is to find the woman and make sure she is safe and well.

Detective Inspector Daniel Daly, from GMP's Rochdale CID, said: “She may be in need of urgent medical attention, and she is our absolute priority at the moment - that is why we are asking anyone with information to contact us.”

Anyone with information, or who may have seen a woman in distress, should call 101 and quote incident number 684 of 22/10/2026.

Information can also be reported online or through GMP's LiveChat service at https://www.gmp.police.uk. Alternatively, contact Crimestoppers anonymously on 0800 555 111.

DI Daly asked the public not to speculate: “We would ask that people don't speculate on the circumstances of this discovery as it hinders our investigation and is upsetting for those involved.”

The information in this report comes from Greater Manchester Police's appeal issued on 22 October 2026. Police have not confirmed further circumstances in that appeal.
